description: This PHP source file defines the class BreadCrumbStack, which manages a stack of breadcrumb items for user navigation history in the SuiteCRM application. It includes functionality for building, maintaining, and filtering a list of breadcrumb items related to user tracking.

classes.name: BreadCrumbStack
classes.description: A class that manages a stack of breadcrumb items for user navigation, tracking recently viewed items, ensuring uniqueness, and providing filtering options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the breadcrumb stack from user tracking data, applying optional module filters.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an item with a given item_id exists in the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new item to the stack, ensuring no duplicates and maintaining maximum history size.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes the oldest item from the stack.

methods.name: makeItemInvisible
methods.description: Changes the visibility status of an item, either deleting or updating its visible flag in the database.

methods.name: popItem
methods.description: Removes a specific item by item_id from the stack.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the internal stack and updates the map.

methods.name: heal
methods.description: Reindexes the stack after removal of items to maintain consistency between array indices and item IDs.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the current number of items in the breadcrumb stack.

methods.name: getBreadCrumbList
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of breadcrumb items, optionally filtered by module name, limited to the most recent 10 entries.
